message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge. Facts: Defendant set fire intentionally to property (ex-wife's house). He used matches/lighter to ignite corn husk etc, then set fire to house, causing damage valued 17905 yuan. He voluntarily surrendered. This is intentional arson. The list includes "放火" (arson) and "故意毁坏财物" (intentional property damage). The difference: "放火" is deliberately setting fire. The facts: He set fire intentionally. So charge is "放火". Not "故意毁坏财物" because that is broader but fire is specific. In examples, similar scenario: "吴某使用打火机点燃其家中三楼...导致财物燃烧" was labeled "放火". So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>.
